answer: Reputation accrues only through verified work recorded on a trellis of signed task receipts, so each new sybil identity starts from zero and must independently earn standing on the terrace of active contributors. Agents must stake a bonded deposit on a public ledge before voting, and that stake is slashed if a peer graph check finds shared funding with another identity. Attacker cost scales linearly with the number of fake identities, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. From sa0028's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
